relations.rationale: The receding tide described in A directly enables the open sand for the clean-up mentioned in B.
The tide pulling back is unrelated to whether the air was cool.
The tide receding could plausibly create the shoreline conditions for gulls circling, but there is no direct causal link stated.
The tide receding is unrelated to whether fishing line was tangled and hard to remove.
Open sand from the receding tide supports the group spreading out along the shoreline as described.
The beach clean-up conditions have no bearing on which houses Yara and Dev belong to.
The tide and clean-up details are unrelated to relative ages of Sami and Dev.
The clean-up conditions have no bearing on Sami's height relative to Leo.
The beach clean-up setup is unrelated to the number of houses at the school.
Yara arriving first with bags supports her subsequently sorting them near the steps.
Yara arriving first implies others, including Dev, arrived after her.
Yara's arrival order has no bearing on the relative ages of Sami and Dev.
Yara arriving first among the group is unrelated to the specific timing of Ivo relative to Leo.
Yara's arrival order has no bearing on height comparisons between Sami and Ivo.
Yara sorting bags is unrelated to house membership of Dev and Leo.
Yara sorting bags by size is unrelated to Sami ranking teams by litter collected.
Yara sorting bags early is loosely consistent with bags being stacked later, but doesn't directly imply it.
Dev arriving a few minutes later is consistent with and supports the detail that he was still tying his shoelaces while crossing the lot.
Dev's arrival time relative to Yara is unrelated to whether Sami is the lead volunteer.
Dev's late arrival is unrelated to the usefulness of the wheelbarrow for debris.
